sloka: ब्रह्मणा सह देवेषु गतेषु च नभःस्थलम् ।विमुक्तो ऽसौ सरस्वत्या स्वां सञ्ज्ञां च ततो गतः ।। ७.१०.४७ ॥
transliteration: brahmaṇā saha deveṣu gateṣu ca nabhaḥsthalam ।vimukto 'sau sarasvatyā svāṁ sañjñāṁ ca tato gataḥ ।। 7.10.47 ॥

translations.english: When Brahma and the gods had ascended to the sky, Kumbhakarna, released by Saraswati, then regained his own consciousness.
